visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a yellow t-shirt and white cardigan, sits in the driver's seat of a car. She holds a pink and yellow 'mini more' Sea Salt Caramel Puff Cake package, then shows the round, tan pastry which has 'WA!' branded on the top. (2) The woman takes a large bite of the puff cake, revealing a creamy light-colored filling. She looks toward the camera with an expressive, satisfied facial gesture while nodding. The car interior is brightly lit by natural daylight. (3) She presents a second item, the 'mini more' Custard Mochi Puff. She removes a white, perfectly round mochi from its plastic tray and repeatedly pokes the soft surface with her finger to demonstrate its elasticity. (4) She takes a bite of the white mochi puff, exposing a bright yellow custard center. Her eyes widen in surprise as she continues to speak to the camera in a medium close-up shot. (5) She reveals a third blue package, the 'mini more' Creme Brulee Tart. She pulls out a star-shaped tart with a golden-brown flaky crust. (6) After taking a bite, she covers her mouth with her hand in a gesture of delight and eventually gives an 'OK' hand sign to the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy electronic pop BGM with a bright synth lead and a driving 4/4 drum beat starts immediately. A female voice speaks with high pitch variability and a very excited, friendly tone. The sound of crinkling plastic packaging is audible as she handles a dessert. (2) The acoustic texture remains bright and compressed. The speaker continues her rapid-fire narration, interspersed with the soft, wet percussive sounds of chewing. A short 'ding' sound effect highlights a specific variety text overlay. (3) A new phase is triggered by a loud plastic rustling sound as she switches to the second item. The speaker's voice becomes more animated, with rising intonations. A distinct squishing sound is audible as she pokes the mochi. (4) The BGM energy remains constant. The speaker emits an 'Oh!' exclamation of surprise. The chewing sounds become more prominent, followed by a series of rapid speech bursts. (5) The final phase features a celebratory tone from the speaker. The music swells slightly before both the vocal and music tracks are ended by a sharp hard cut.

The creator emphasizes the texture (softness) and flavor profile of the products through expressive eating and enthusiastic commentary.
